Sign In Solutions VMS API (0.20.2)

Download OpenAPI specification:

API Support: support@tractionguest.com URL: https://signinsolutions.com/signinenterprise

The Traction Guest API is currently under limited release to select customers as we gather and iterate on feedback.

Getting Started

If you are interested in getting early access to the API, please send us an email to support@tractionguest.com.

We will also add you to our Slack channel where you can ask questions and get further help.

Terms and Conditions

Please visit: https://signinsolutions.com/compliance-hub

Versioning

This API follows semantic versioning, which follows the Major.Minor.Patch format.

  • The Major number increments when potentially incompatible changes are made.
  • The Minor number increments when backwards-compatible additions are made.
  • The Patch number increments when backwards-compatible bug-fixes are made.

Create a Host

Creates a Host

Authorizations:
TractionGuestAuth
header Parameters
Idempotency-Key
string

An optional idempotency key to allow for repeat API requests. Any API request with this key will only be executed once, no matter how many times it's submitted. We store idempotency keys for only 24 hours. Any Idempotency-Key shorter than 10 characters will be ignored

Request Body schema: application/json
required
email
string
first_name
string
last_name
string
profile_pic_url
string
department
string
mobile_number
string

Create multiple Hosts

Creates a batch of Host records in an async queue. Please note, every action taken against this endpoint is recorded in the audit log.

Authorizations:
TractionGuestAuth
header Parameters
Idempotency-Key
string

An optional idempotency key to allow for repeat API requests. Any API request with this key will only be executed once, no matter how many times it's submitted. We store idempotency keys for only 24 hours. Any Idempotency-Key shorter than 10 characters will be ignored

Request Body schema: application/json
Array of objects (HostCreateParams)

Responses

/{domain}/hosts/batch

Content type
application/json
No sample

  • "created_at": "date-string",

}

path Parameters

required
mobile_number
string
Array of objects (NotificationTrigger)
first_name
required
string

integer

object

List all Invites

Gets a list of all Invite entities.

Authorizations:
TractionGuestAuth
query Parameters
limit
integer

Limits the results to a specified number, defaults to 50

offset
integer

Offsets the results to a specified number, defaults to 0

query
string

Filters by first_name, last_name, company, and email

with_colours
string

A comma separated list of case-insensitive colour values. i.e., red, green, yellow, and orange

location_ids
string

A comma separated list of Location IDs

sort_by
any
Enum: "start_date_asc" "start_date_desc" "end_date_asc" "end_date_desc" "created_at_asc" "created_at_desc" "updated_at_asc" "updated_at_desc"

Sorts by the field name and direction provided where the pattern is FIELD_NAME_DIRECTION

starts_before
string <date>

Filters results to all those before the provided datetime

starts_after
string <date>

Filters results to all those after the provided datetime

include
string

A list of comma-separated related models to include i.e., 'assigned_stall'

is_approved
boolean

True to return approved and auto approved invites, False to return pending and rejected invites

active_after
string <date-time>

Checks that an invite hasn't yet started, or has started and is still active after a specified time

active_before
string <date-time>

Checks that an invite hasn't ended before a specified time

Responses

/{domain}/invites

Update Package

Update/Edit information about a Package.

picked_up - changes the package_state to picked up and assigns non null value to picked_up_at

recipient_id - update the package's intended recipient. Changes package_state to 'recipient_matched' if a match hasn't been found and notifies host about their package via email. A previous recipient will stop getting notifications

carrier_name - change/update the package's carrier/courier information

Update a Signin

Update, acknowledge, or Signout a Signin

Authorizations:
TractionGuestAuth
path Parameters
signin_id
required
string
header Parameters
Idempotency-Key
string

An optional idempotency key to allow for repeat API requests. Any API request with this key will only be executed once, no matter how many times it's submitted. We store idempotency keys for only 24 hours. Any Idempotency-Key shorter than 10 characters will be ignored

Request Body schema: application/json
required

The only updatable values for a Signin are badge_number, badge_returned, is_accounted_for, is_signed_out, and is_acknowledged. is_signed_out and is_acknowledged are pseudo attributes that once set to true, are irreversible.

is_signed_out
boolean

Used to sign out the Signin, can only be set to true.

is_acknowledged
boolean

Used to acknowledge the Signin, can only be set to true.

is_accounted_for
boolean

Used when keeping track of people in emergency situations

Responses

/{domain}/signins/{signin_id}

Request samples

  • Payload
Content type
application/json
{

List all Signins

Gets a list of all Signin entities.

Authorizations:
TractionGuestAuth
query Parameters
location_ids
string

A comma separated list of Location IDs

with_colours
string

A comma separated list of case-insensitive colour values. i.e., red, green, yellow, and orange

query
string

Allows you to query by company, email, first_name, last_name, and location_name

with_acknowledged
boolean

Filters to all those Signins that have, or have not been acknowledged

with_signed_in
boolean

Filters to all Signins that are, or are not currently signed out.

signin_before
string <date>

Filters results to all those before the provided datetime

signin_after
string <date>

Filters results to all those after the provided datetime

limit
integer

Limits the results to a specified number, defaults to 50

offset
integer

Offsets the results to a specified number, defaults to 0

query_sort
string
Enum: "signin_timestamp_desc" "signin_timestamp_asc"

Allows you to override ordering by most relevant results when querying

include
string

A list of comma-separated related models to include

include_anonymized
boolean

Set this flag to true to include anonymized signins in the response

Responses

/{domain}/signins

Create Signin

Creates a Signin

Authorizations:
TractionGuestAuth
Request Body schema: application/json

Params for creating a Signin can omit certain fields if a registration_id is present.

registration_id
string

UUID of a Registration

email
string

E-mail, ignored if registration_id is included

company
string

Company name, ignored if registration_id is included

last_name
string

Last name, ignored if registration_id is included

first_name
string

First name, ignored if registration_id is included

sms_message
string
send_notifications
boolean
location_id
integer

ID of the Location where the Signin happened, ignored if registration_id is included

host_ids
Array of integers

Array of Host ids, ignored if registration_id is included

host_email_template_id
integer
guest_email_template_id
integer

limit
integer

offset
integer

Offsets the results to a specified number, defaults to 0

location_ids
string

created_before
string

Restricts results to only those that were created before the provided date

created_after
string

Restricts results to only those that were created after the provided date

needs_confirmation
boolean

A confirmed Registration is one with an associated Invite. This filter returns those without an Invite when true, and those with an Invite when false.

Get the capacity details for a location

Gets the details of the future capacity in a location.

Authorizations:
TractionGuestAuth
path Parameters
location_id
required
string
query Parameters
hours_to_forecast
integer [ 1 .. 24 ]
Default: 8

The next N number of hours, the data needs to be calculated. Range from 1 to 24. If not set, it defaults to 8.

timestamp
string

ISO8601 timestamp(includes the offset value) to use as the start point for the capacity estimate report. Defaults to the current local timestamp of the location if not provided. Eg: "2020-07-16T17:05:08-07:00"

Responses

/{domain}/locations/{location_id}/capacity_forecasts

GroupVisits

List all Group Visits (Appointments)

Gets a list of all GroupVisit entities (Appointments).

Authorizations:
TractionGuestAuth
query Parameters
limit
string

Limits the results to a specified number. Defaults to 50.

offset
string

Offsets the results to a specified number. Defaults to 0.

location_ids
string

A comma-separated string of locations IDs, to only show group visits (appointments) from those locations.

sort_with
string

A combination of attribute and direction, joined with an underscore, for sorting. Valid attributes are: created_at, updated_at, name, and start_time. Valid directions are asc and desc. E.g., name_desc, start_time_asc.
